title: Trip.com: 14% Cashback on Hotels (Uncapped) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: Trip.com: 14% Cashback on Hotels (Uncapped) @ TopCashback AU

[SBOB] Decent %, but I've found Trip more expensive (even with cashback) for my recent 'family' suitable hotel searches in Shanghai/Beijing/HK.
You'd think they would be the cheapest considering thats their core home market area.
[Zark] With what other platforms did you compare?
[SBOB] my current bookings are with expedia (though HK is currently direct booking)
[Pacbough] Interested to know what platform you used too. I used trip last time and it was a smooth experience. Got bait and switched with another website before.
[Charlie Dont Surf] Always find Trip.com the best for those locations - some other platforms don't even show the hotel listed, or availability of the hotel on the same dates.
[SBOB] happy to hear any hotel rec's for those locations. Been aiming to find 'family' for 4 suitable accom (without necessarily booking 2 rooms and hoping for adjoining/adjacent)
China rookie. Currently took popular recommendations from social media posts and have Novotel/Ascott/Dorsett for SH/BJ/HK
[Pacbough] I just checked Expedia and it's missing a lot of the more budget hotels. I'm looking in Hangzhou and last year I also checked Expedia and had the same results. My girlfriend uses cTrip which is just chinese trip, it has more options but I'm pretty sure the hotels/airbnbs that don't show up on the English localized Trip don't want to accept foreigners.
[SBOB] @Pacbough: Yeah, for sure the hotel choice is less compared to trip.com.
As it's a family trip so mid-level and up hotels (and as a China rookie, ones often well reviewed by western tourists) is more our target. My ozb spirit has to be dialled down a bit for family holidays :)
[Pacbough] @SBOB: @SBOB Haha fair enough, oh the sacrifices we make. :)
To be honest I was pleasantly surprised by the hotels we stayed at last year, for the price they were excellent. One place even had free breakfast which was quite decent. Only complaint was cigarette smell from past guests but that was cleared by turning on the aircon for a bit and leaving it on. The cheap hotels were older but for around $30 a night, no complaints. Cleaner than I expected, certainly better than cheap aussie airbnbs I've stayed in before (cockroach infestation).
If language barrier is your concern then I guess the larger hotel chains would probably be better equipped with English speaking staff. The staff at the hotels I stayed at likely had very limited or no English, I speak Mandarin so that wasn't a problem for me. They were very polite and helpful though, might even have the patience to deal with someone using a translator app haha.
[knowskillz] I travelled and checked out in March this year still haven't got the cashback, raised a request to get it looked into but it's still pending on customer service for 3 weeks now and it says the "Expected Cashback" is only 4% instead of the higher promotional offer during the time.
[VincentQQ] I booked a non-refundable hotel in Cairns a week before my trip, but the price dropped by ~20% the following day. The hotel wouldn't adjust it, but Trip.com’s Price Guarantee saved the day.
After being guided by AI, I submitted a claim. It was approved fairly quick, and I received the difference back in Trip Coins after check-out.
Not sure if other OTA has similar benefits.
[VincentQQ] Showing tracked at the moment. Trip was in September, guess will find out later.
[Alanw] Does new user promotion (automatically applied) invalidate the cashback?
[apple0604] Yes, need to make sure removing the new user discount.
[Tommybot] Seasoned China visitors, should I go for this deal or wait until the Singles Day promotions?
[Charlie Dont Surf] There will be another ~14% cashback deal from either TCB or SB after that, so you could possibly wait. Or even some smaller cashback in conjunction with 11.11 to come out in front.
[apple0604] Does anyone know if payment by PayPal will result in cashback rejected?
[ginger-gin] Doesn't matter as long as no code input and it's tracked
